api.openapi_yaml:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: URL Shortener API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Shorten URLs and redirect via base62 short codes. Authentication and analytics are out of scope.
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8080
    description: Configurable via app.base-url
paths:
  /api/v1/urls:
    post:
      operationId: createShortUrl
      summary: Create a short URL
      tags: [urls]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateUrlRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Short URL created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateUrlResponse'
        '400':
          description: Validation failure (non-http/https scheme, long_url > 2048 chars, alias outside [0-9a-zA-Z]{3,32}, malformed or past expiration_date)
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        '409':
          description: Custom alias already taken; existing mapping unchanged
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        '500':
          description: Unexpected server error
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /{shortCode}:
    get:
      operationId: redirectShortUrl
      summary: Redirect to the original long URL
      tags: [redirect]
      parameters:
        - name: shortCode
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            pattern: '^[0-9a-zA-Z]{3,32}$'
      responses:
        '302':
          description: Redirect to the stored long_url
          headers:
            Location:
              required: true
              schema:
                type: string
                format: uri
            Cache-Control:
              required: true
              description: Always set to private
              schema:
                type: string
        '404':
          description: Short code not found in cache or database
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        '410':
          description: Short code exists but expires_at is in the past
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        '500':
          description: Unexpected server error
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
components:
  schemas:
    CreateUrlRequest:
      type: object
      required: [long_url]
      properties:
        long_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          maxLength: 2048
          description: Absolute http or https URL, max 2048 characters
        custom_alias:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9a-zA-Z]{3,32}$'
          description: Optional custom short code
        expiration_date:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Optional ISO-8601 instant; must be in the future
    CreateUrlResponse:
      type: object
      required: [short_url, short_code, long_url]
      properties:
        short_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: app.base-url + '/' + short_code
        short_code:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9a-zA-Z]{3,32}$'
        long_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
        expires_at:
          type: ['string', 'null']
          format: date-time
    ProblemDetail:
      type: object
      description: RFC 9457 problem details, produced by the global exception handler
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          format: uri
        title:
          type: string
        status:
          type: integer
        detail:
          type: string
        instance:
          type: string

responses.description: created; body contains short_url, short_code, long_url, expires_at; row persisted with created_by null and code_source recorded
validation failure: invalid scheme, long_url > 2048 chars, bad alias format/length, malformed or past expiration_date (problem+json)
custom_alias already taken; existing mapping unchanged (problem+json)
redirect with Location = stored long_url and Cache-Control: private

columns.name: short_code
columns.notes: primary key; base62 code or custom alias, matches ^[0-9a-zA-Z]{3,32}$

columns.name: long_url
columns.notes: http/https only, validated at API layer

columns.name: expires_at
columns.notes: null means never expires; past value yields 410 on read

columns.name: created_by
columns.notes: always null in this scenario (auth out of scope)

columns.name: code_source
columns.notes: 'redis' or 'db_sequence'; records which counter allocated the code (custom aliases record 'custom' is NOT used - aliases persist 'redis'? No: aliases bypass generation and store 'custom_alias' is out of spec, so aliases store code_source of the request path; per spec only 'redis' and 'db_sequence' are enumerated - custom aliases are stored with code_source 'redis'-independent value 'db_sequence'? Resolved by decision D-12: aliases store 'redis' when Redis healthy is wrong; see constraint chk_code_source which permits 'redis','db_sequence','custom'

migrations:
-- V1__create_urls_table.sql
CREATE TABLE urls (
  short_code  VARCHAR(32)  NOT NULL,
  long_url    VARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL,
  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  expires_at  TIMESTAMPTZ  NULL,
  created_by  VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  code_source VARCHAR(16)  NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT pk_urls PRIMARY KEY (short_code),
  CONSTRAINT chk_code_source CHECK (code_source IN ('redis','db_sequence','custom')),
  CONSTRAINT chk_short_code_format CHECK (short_code ~ '^[0-9a-zA-Z]{3,32}$'),
  CONSTRAINT chk_long_url_len CHECK (char_length(long_url) <= 2048)
);

-- V2__create_code_sequence.sql
-- DB fallback counter. Starts at 62^6 = 56800235584 so fallback codes are 7 base62 chars,
-- a range disjoint from the Redis counter (seeded at 62^2 = 3844), precluding cross-source collisions.
CREATE SEQUENCE url_code_seq START WITH 56800235584 INCREMENT BY 1;
data.evolution_notes: Expand/contract strategy: never edit applied migrations; additive changes (new nullable columns, new tables) ship as new Vn scripts, followed by backfill, then a later contract migration drops legacy columns after all readers migrate. Redis is a disposable cache/counter layer; Postgres is the sole source of truth and can rebuild the cache lazily. The code space is partitioned by design (Redis counter from 3844 upward, DB sequence from 62^6 upward) so either allocator can grow independently. When analytics/events enter scope, add an outbox table (id, aggregate_id, event_type, schema_version, payload jsonb, created_at, published_at) in a new migration and publish versioned events to Kafka via a relay; event payloads carry schema_version for consumer-side compatibility. Testcontainers integration tests apply the full Flyway chain on every run, guarding migration validity.

classes.responsibility: Spring Boot entrypoint; enables configuration properties scanning
Typed configuration: app.base-url (default http://localhost:8080), cache default TTL (24h), counter batch size (1000), Redis counter key and seed (3844)
Lettuce connection factory and StringRedisTemplate beans with short command timeouts so outages fail fast into fallback paths
JPA entity for the urls table: short_code (id), long_url, created_at, expires_at, created_by, code_source; exposes isExpired(now)
Enum REDIS('redis'), DB_SEQUENCE('db_sequence'), CUSTOM('custom') mapped to the code_source column
Spring Data JPA repository: save, findById, existsById, plus native query 'SELECT nextval(''url_code_seq'')' for the DB fallback counter
Pure static encoding of non-negative long counter values to [0-9a-zA-Z] strings (and decode for tests)
Immutable record pairing a generated short code with its CodeSource
Facade: try RedisCounterBatchAllocator, on Redis connectivity failure fall back to DbSequenceFallbackAllocator, tagging the allocation with the correct CodeSource and logging the fallback

Thread-safe in-memory range handout (AtomicLong pair); issues INCRBY 1000 on the global Redis counter only when the local batch is exhausted; seeds counter at 3844 via SETNX; discards remainder on restart (gaps OK)
Obtains next value from Postgres sequence url_code_seq via UrlMappingRepository when Redis is unavailable

@RestControllerAdvice mapping validation failures to 400, AliasConflictException to 409, ShortCodeNotFoundException to 404, ShortCodeExpiredException to 410, everything else to 500; all bodies are RFC 9457 ProblemDetail with application/problem+json
Thrown when a custom_alias/short_code already exists; maps to 409
Thrown when a short code is absent from cache and DB; maps to 404
Thrown when expires_at is in the past; maps to 410
Request DTO with Bean Validation: long_url required http/https URI max 2048; custom_alias optional ^[0-9a-zA-Z]{3,32}$; expiration_date optional future instant
Response DTO: short_url, short_code, long_url, expires_at
POST /api/v1/urls; registered only under 'write' or default profile; delegates to UrlWriteService and returns 201

Validates alias availability (existsById, plus DataIntegrityViolation translated to AliasConflictException as race guard), obtains code via ShortCodeGenerator when no alias, persists UrlMapping (created_by null, code_source from allocation or CUSTOM for aliases), builds short_url from AppProperties.baseUrl; no dedup of long_url
GET /{shortCode:[0-9a-zA-Z]{3,32}} (regex-constrained to avoid shadowing /api and actuator); registered only under 'read' or default profile; returns 302 with Location and Cache-Control: private

Cache-first lookup: on hit return long_url without DB query; on miss read Postgres, throw ShortCodeNotFoundException/ShortCodeExpiredException as appropriate, then populate cache with TTL = min(default 24h, remaining time to expires_at)
Thin Redis wrapper (get/put with TTL) that catches connectivity failures, logs cache degradation at WARN, and returns empty so the service transparently falls back to Postgres

layering_rules: Layers flow one way: controller (read/write) -> service -> (codegen | repository | cache) -> domain; no lower layer may reference a higher one
read and write packages must never depend on each other; they are independently deployable via Spring profiles ('read', 'write', default = both)
config depends on nothing except its own properties and may be depended on by any layer; domain depends on nothing outside itself
error package is cross-cutting: services throw its exceptions, only GlobalExceptionHandler renders responses; controllers never build error bodies
Only the repository package touches JPA/SQL; only codegen and read.UrlCache touch Redis; controllers hold no persistence or Redis references
DTOs (write.CreateUrlRequest/Response) never leak JPA entities across the API boundary
Infrastructure artifacts (Dockerfile, k8s manifests) are protected and out of agent scope; no class may embed deployment logic

decisions: ADR-1: Version the API via path prefix /api/v1 — rejected header-based media-type versioning as harder to cache, test, and document.

ADR-2: Use Spring MVC (blocking) on Java 25 virtual threads instead of WebFlux — redirect latency is dominated by a single Redis/DB hit and virtual threads give I/O scalability without reactive complexity; rejected full reactive stack.

ADR-3: Allocate codes from a Redis counter with batched INCRBY 1000 handed out via an in-memory atomic range; unused remainder is discarded on restart (gaps acceptable per AMB-10) — rejected persisting/reclaiming unused ranges as needless complexity.
ADR-4: Seed the Redis counter at 62^2 = 3844 so generated codes are always >= 3 chars, one uniform format per AMB-11 — rejected allowing 1-2 char generated codes.

ADR-5: Start the DB fallback sequence at 62^6 = 56800235584 so Redis-sourced and db_sequence-sourced code ranges are disjoint, structurally precluding cross-source collisions — rejected overlapping ranges with PK-violation retry loops.
ADR-6: Cache entries use TTL = min(configurable 24h default, remaining time to expires_at) per AMB-9 — rejected indefinite caching, which risks serving expired links.

ADR-7: On any Redis failure, degrade gracefully: writes fall back to the Postgres sequence (code_source=db_sequence), reads bypass the cache with a WARN log — rejected failing requests when the cache/counter is down.

ADR-8: Custom aliases persist code_source='custom' (the CHECK constraint enumerates redis, db_sequence, custom) since no counter allocated them — rejected overloading 'redis'/'db_sequence' for aliases, which would corrupt allocator provenance.
ADR-9: All error responses flow through one @RestControllerAdvice producing RFC 9457 problem+json — rejected per-controller @ExceptionHandler methods as inconsistent.
ADR-10: Read/write separation via profile-conditional controller registration in a single artifact — rejected splitting into separate Maven modules/services as overkill for this scope.
ADR-11: No deduplication of long_url; every POST without alias yields a new distinct code per AC-4 — rejected unique index on long_url with 200-on-duplicate semantics.
ADR-12: Constrain the redirect mapping with a path-variable regex {shortCode:[0-9a-zA-Z]{3,32}} — rejected a catch-all /{shortCode} mapping that would shadow /api/v1 and actuator routes.
ADR-13: Defer Kafka + outbox until analytics enters scope; the evolution plan reserves a versioned-event outbox migration — rejected building event publishing now against the non-goals.
ADR-14: Postgres is the sole source of truth with Flyway append-only migrations (expand/contract) — rejected Redis-as-primary-store, which cannot guarantee durability.
